title: Solid Trapdoors
description: New trapdoors more immersive — no more accidental openings. These wooden trapdoors behave just like vanilla ones, but can only be opened or closed if you're holding a stick, making them perfect for use as walls, floors, or decorative details.
body:
🪵 Immersive Trapdoors – Only open with a stick!

This mod adds functional copies of all vanilla wooden trapdoors with a twist: they can only be opened or closed while you're holding a stick. If you're not holding a stick, they behave like solid, static blocks — no accidental clicks, no surprise openings.

This is perfect for builders and roleplayers who want to use trapdoors as walls, floors, ceilings, furniture, or hidden passages without worrying about immersion-breaking misclicks.

The new trapdoors look and behave exactly like their vanilla counterparts — same models, same textures — but are fully controlled by the player’s hand.

🧱 Features:

All six wooden trapdoor types (oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak) included

Fully immersive: trapdoors can’t open unless you’re holding a stick

No accidental interactions — great for decoration or structural use

Included in the minecraft:wooden_trapdoors block tag for full compatibility

Perfect for adventure maps, roleplay, or detailed builds

🎮 Compatibility:

Works in singleplayer and multiplayer

Compatible with most mods and datapacks that rely on vanilla tags

📌 Note: These are not replacements — they are new blocks. You’ll find them in the redstone or building tabs depending on your creative inventory.

Make your builds cleaner, safer, and more immersive — one stick at a time!
